title: Skeleton Fairy with Serpent
description: A skeletal fairy with large white feathered wings and long golden hair sits on a ruined wooden throne wearing a purple gown and a crown. A massive white and green serpent coils around her while five robed skeletons stand in a line to the right amid swirling red and green smoke.
prompt: A skeletal fairy with large white feathered wings and flowing golden hair sits on a decaying wooden throne wearing a purple robe and crown. A giant white serpent with green patterns coils around her body and throne. Five robed skeletons stand in formation to the right surrounded by swirling red and green smoke. Sunflowers and scattered papers lie on the broken stone floor, dramatic sunset lighting over ruined classical architecture in the background, dark fantasy style.
